name: ShadowClaw DAW
description: In-browser Digital Audio Workstation powered by Web Audio API, Web Components, WebMCP and ShadowClaw.

skills.name: acid-jam
skills.description: Create and perform acid house and techno jams with the Cubed TB-303 synthesizer, diode ladder filter sweeps, accent recharge dynamics, and slide portamento.

skills.name: beat
skills.description: Program or update a drum and bass rhythm for techno-bass, pop, house, trap, or synthwave styles.

skills.name: bounce
skills.description: Render the project offline into a broadcast 16/24/32-bit WAV audio file, multi-track stems ZIP, or Standard MIDI file.

skills.name: jam
skills.description: Compose a musical synthesizer bassline or chord melody in a chosen musical key.

skills.name: lofi-session
skills.description: Arrange cozy lofi chillhop and ambient tracks with warm noise pads, detuned tape drift, humanized jazz chords, and crunchy vinyl drums.

skills.name: mixdown
skills.description: Analyze audio meter levels and automatically adjust track gains to eliminate clipping and achieve balanced headroom.

skills.name: scdaw-audio-clip
skills.description: Manage audio tracks, arrange audio clips, set clip offsets and gains, and configure auxiliary track sends for bus processing.

skills.name: scdaw-automate
skills.description: Create, edit, and clear continuous parameter automation envelopes (volume fades, pan sweeps, and filter cutoff modulation) on DAW tracks.

skills.name: scdaw-doctor
skills.description: Diagnose workbench connectivity, browser audio autoplay unlock state, and leader election.

skills.name: scdaw-record
skills.description: Manage audio recording arms, configure metronome click tracks, and record live microphone/line-in audio takes.

skills.name: scdaw-status
skills.description: Check DAW playback state, BPM, current playhead position, and audio engine status.

skills.name: skill-creator
skills.description: Create, edit, review, and validate ShadowClaw declarative skills and their supporting resources.

skills.name: song
skills.description: Compose, arrange, or set up a complete multi-track song from high-level prompt, style description, or reference track.

skills.name: soundfont-orchestra
skills.description: Build orchestral and acoustic multi-instrument arrangements using the SoundFont General MIDI engine and SoundFont banks.

skills.name: toast-random-number
skills.description: Generate a random integer from 1 to 1000000 and show it in a ShadowClaw toast notification.

skills.name: trap-beat
skills.description: Produce hard-hitting modern trap beats featuring gliding 808 sub bass, Karplus-Strong plucked melodies, half-time snares, and fast hi-hat rolls.

tools.name: generate_random_number
tools.description: Generate a random integer within a specified range (min through max, inclusive).

tools.name: scdaw_add_audio_clip
tools.description: Add an audio clip (sample, vocal take, stem) to an audio track at a specified time position in beats.

tools.name: scdaw_add_track
tools.description: Add a new instrument track ('drums' or 'synth') with custom name and initial synthesis parameters.

tools.name: scdaw_analyze_mix
tools.description: Analyze the current mix levels, dynamic range, clipping, and 3-band energy distribution (low, mid, high) across a specified duration. Returns peak dBFS, RMS dBFS, crest factor, and actionable mix suggestions.

tools.name: scdaw_apply_groove
tools.description: Apply micro-timing groove templates (Zeitgeist: mpc60, sp1200, swing16, shuffle, laidback, rushed) or humanize timing and velocity on a track.

tools.name: scdaw_apply_preset
tools.description: Apply a curated synthesizer preset ('init-saw', 'techno-bass', 'acid-303', 'pop-pluck', 'warm-pad', 'sub-808', 'supersaw-lead') to a synth track.

tools.name: scdaw_bounce
tools.description: Render project offline into a WAV audio file (16-bit, 24-bit, or 32-bit Float) via OfflineAudioContext, initiating browser download and returning audio metadata.

tools.name: scdaw_clear_automation
tools.description: Clear continuous automation points for a specific track parameter, or clear all automation for the track if no parameter is specified.

tools.name: scdaw_clear_notes
tools.description: Clear notes on a specific track, optionally within a specified step range.

tools.name: scdaw_clear_project_notes
tools.description: Clears all notes across all tracks in the project, preserving tracks, instruments, and effects.

tools.name: scdaw_compose_song
tools.description: Compile a complete multi-bar, multi-track song in one call from a high-level SongSpec (chords, feel, tempo, sections, form, instrumentation, custom riffs). Supports SoundFont GM instruments (electric-bass-finger, acoustic-guitar-steel, electric-guitar-clean, overdriven-guitar, rock-organ, rock-kit) for realistic audio, multiple chords per bar (e.g. 'F Bb | C Bb'), and custom riffs with rests (e.g. motifs: { bass: 'F2:8 F2:8 r:8 A2:8 C3:8' }). Example: scdaw_compose_song({ title: 'Keep on the Sunny Side', bpm: 86, feel: 'blues-rock', swing: 0.3, instruments: { drums: 'rock-kit', bass: 'electric-bass-finger', rhythm: 'electric-guitar-clean', lead: 'overdriven-guitar' }, sections: [{ name: 'verse', bars: 8, chords: 'F Bb | C Bb' }], form: ['verse'] })

tools.name: scdaw_configure_fx
tools.description: Add, update, or remove an audio effect (autotune, vocoder, maximizer, tidal, transient, sidechain, fold, crusher, delay, reverb, stereoTool) on a track.

tools.name: scdaw_describe_arrangement
tools.description: Inspect and return a human-readable summary of the active project arrangement (tempo, signature, total bars, track roles, note counts, and looping state) to verify structure.

tools.name: scdaw_export_midi
tools.description: Exports the active song or track notes as a Standard MIDI File (.mid) Format 1 (multi-track) or Format 0 (single track), baking active MIDI FX and swing.

tools.name: scdaw_export_project
tools.description: Exports the current project as a native .scdaw.json schema or a DAWproject v1.0 interchange archive (.dawproject) to OPFS conversation storage and/or browser download.

tools.name: scdaw_export_stems
tools.description: Renders consolidated Bar 1 Beat 1 audio stems across all tracks with multi-tap routing (post-fader, pre-fader, pre-fx), silence-tail trimming, and bundles stems, MIDI, and project into a ZIP archive.

tools.name: scdaw_get_levels
tools.description: Read real-time peak and RMS audio decibel meter levels for master bus and all active tracks.

tools.name: scdaw_get_project
tools.description: Return the complete project JSON graph including all tracks, notes, volume, pan, and synthesis parameters.

tools.name: scdaw_get_status
tools.description: Return current DAW playback position, audio engine state, track count, BPM, and recent bounce metrics.

tools.name: scdaw_import_midi
tools.description: Imports a Standard MIDI File (.mid) buffer or base64 data into the DAW project or a target track.

tools.name: scdaw_import_project
tools.description: Imports a project from native .scdaw.json or .dawproject archive data (JSON string or Base64 string).

tools.name: scdaw_load_project
tools.description: Validate and load a complete DAW project schema into the active workbench session, or load an existing project file from OPFS conversation storage.

tools.name: scdaw_manage_fx
tools.description: Add, update, reset, or remove an audio effect ('fold', 'crusher', 'stereoTool', 'delay', 'reverb', 'compressor', 'revamp') or MIDI effect ('arpeggio', 'pitch', 'velocity') on a track.

tools.name: scdaw_new_project
tools.description: Create and initialize a new project from a template ('basic-beat' or 'empty').

tools.name: scdaw_panic
tools.description: Emergency All Notes Off: immediately silences all active synthesizer voices and stops the transport.

tools.name: scdaw_play
tools.description: Start playback of the looping pattern.

tools.name: scdaw_record_arm
tools.description: Arm or disarm an audio track for live recording.

tools.name: scdaw_remove_track
tools.description: Remove an existing track from the project by track ID.

tools.name: scdaw_render_surface
tools.description: Return custom element HTML tag to embed the live DAW workbench, mixer, transport, or sequencer surface in chat.

tools.name: scdaw_reset
tools.description: Reset parameter, device, track, pattern notes, or entire project to defaults (supports scopes: 'param', 'track', 'pattern', 'project').

tools.name: scdaw_set_808
tools.description: Configure and shape an authentic 808 sub bass voice with portamento glide, drive, decay, tone, and harmonics presets.

tools.name: scdaw_set_audio_clip
tools.description: Update properties (time, duration, offset, gain, name) of an existing audio clip on an audio track.

tools.name: scdaw_set_automation
tools.description: Set or update continuous parameter automation points (time in beats, value) for a track parameter such as 'volume', 'pan', or 'cutoff'.

tools.name: scdaw_set_instrument
tools.description: Set the synthesis instrument on an existing track (808, cubed, pluck, tubular, neon, noise-pad, korpus, nano, soundfont, synth, drums).

tools.name: scdaw_set_metronome
tools.description: Toggle the metronome click track and configure click volume.

tools.name: scdaw_set_track
tools.description: Adjust track mixing parameters (volume, pan, mute, solo) or synthesis parameters (waveform, cutoff, resonance, ADSR).

tools.name: scdaw_set_track_send
tools.description: Configure an auxiliary send routing level (0.0 to 1.0) from a source track to a destination track or submix.

tools.name: scdaw_set_transport
tools.description: Update transport properties: BPM (40-240), signature ([4,4] or [3,4]), pattern length in bars (1-4), or swing factor (0-0.5).

tools.name: scdaw_stop
tools.description: Stop playback and rewind the transport playhead to the start of the loop.

tools.name: scdaw_undo
tools.description: Undo the last project edit, restoring the previous snapshot from the undo history stack.

tools.name: scdaw_write_notes
tools.description: Write or merge notes into a track. Supports step indices (0-15 per bar), musical beat units, or raw PPQN pulses. Pitch can be MIDI number, note name ('C4'), or drum name ('kick', 'snare', 'hat', 'clap').
